QuestInfo.name: [Event] Super Secret Recipe
QuestInfo.0: Blair is preparing for the cooking contest. There are many outstanding chefs, so an ultra-special recipe is needed to beat Mrs. Baek. The animals of Maple World are rumored to have their own secret recipes, but how can you find them?\r\n\r\n#r(Caution! This quest is available only once per world. If you forfeit during the quest you will not be able to start it again.)
QuestInfo.1:
Blair is preparing for the cooking contest. You can help by getting an amazing secret recipe from the animals of Maple World. Try dressing up like the different animals to get in good with them.

#bPut on the Harp Seal clothes to talk to the Harp Seal.
Put on the Puffram clothes to talk to the Puffram.
Put on the Chicken Smackaroo clothes to talk to the Chicken Smackaroo.

#r(Caution! This quest is available only once per world. If you forfeit during the quest you will not be able to start it again.)
QuestInfo.2:
Lady Blair got the secret recipe from Chicken Smackaroo's source. The ultra special dish that was created is a 'Chick-n-Roll'. You can savor the tender meat, refreshing sauce, and the greens AND feel full. 

You received #b#t3015223##k as a token of gratitude.

#r(Caution! This quest is available only once per world. If you forfeit during the quest you will not be able to start it again.)
